turns.q: Can I change the shipping address on an order I just placed?
turns.replyTail:
hipping address on an order I just placed?

Yes, you may be able to, as long as your order hasn’t entered processing yet.

Shipping address changes have to be handled over the phone so our team can update the address and correctly recalculate any taxes tied to the new location.

Please call our customer care team as soon as you can so they can help update it:

Our team can be reached at (800) 820-0465. We are available Monday–Friday 6:00AM–4:00PM and Saturday 8:00AM–4:00PM PST.
